repairs.issue: 누락된그림자·재사용·대상지정불가예외·추가유지 복원, 표식3초 조건과 배율역할 명시
repairs.correction: 아래 ruleChecks에 기록된 최종 조건·대상·단위로 최소 수정; before 원본과 candidate 비교 가능
repairs.quote: Zed becomes Untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds, the mark triggers, dealing (100% Attack Damage) physical damage and repeating 25/40/55% of all damage dealt to the target by Zed while the mark was active. The dash leaves a Shadow behind for 7.5 seconds. Zed can Recast this Ability to switch positions with this Shadow. Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them. The Shadow remains for an extra 1.5 seconds after the recast window ends.

proposalDecisions.reason: 같은cast규칙의 세 효과는 원문 한 흐름과 일치하며 별도적중/도달 판정을 단정하지 않는다. 제안 스스로도 추가적중조건을 요구할 수 없다고 한다.
